text: 近日，花旗集团、渣打银行、瑞银等多家国际知名投行密集更新A股市场研报，纷纷上调市场评级与盈利预期，看多中国股市的共识持续强化。 看多中国资产的同时，外资入市布局也在加快。截至2026年二季度末，北向资金持股数量合计超过1078亿股，环比增加超过40亿股。按照二季度末收盘价计算，北向资金持股市值超过3万亿元，达到3.13万亿元，创互联互通机制开通以来季度新高。从持仓结构来看，外资偏好硬科技资产的特征明显。（中证报）
text_en: Recently, Citigroup, Standard Chartered, UBS and other major international investment banks intensively updated A-share market research reports, raising market ratings and earnings forecasts, strengthening consensus on bullish outlook for Chinese stocks. While bullish on Chinese assets, foreign capital inflows accelerated. As of end-Q2 2026, northbound holdings exceeded 107.8 billion shares, up over 4 billion shares quarter-on-quarter. At end-Q2 closing prices, northbound market value exceeded RMB 3 trillion, reaching RMB 3.13 trillion, a quarterly record since connect mechanism launch. By holding structure, foreign funds favored hard-tech assets. (China Securities Journal)
